sentences.text:
BETWEEN:-
 SAJID S/O RAJJAK MANSURI, AGED 26 YEARS,

OCCUPATION: LABOR R/O VILLAGE PURVI LODH  DISTT. MANDSAUR (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI YASH PAL RATHORE - ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION NAHARGARH DISTRICT MANDSAUR  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI KAPIL MAHANT - PANEL LAWYER)
 This application coming on for admission this day, th  following:
 ORDER

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.470/2023 registered at Police Station Nahargarh, District Mandsaur (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 450, 376(1), 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2. Learned counsel for state informed that earlier offence under sections 354 and 506 IPC has been registered against the applicant in respect of outrage the modesty of the same prosecutrix.
3 After arguing for sometime learned counsel for applicant seeks permission to withdraw the M.Cr.C. with liberty to renew the prayer after examination of prosecutrix before the trial court.
5. M.Cr.C. is accordingly dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed.
